public_rationale: Under the broad contextual reading, internal planning is a counterexample to “everything else” being added around the model. Anthropic traced advance planning and altered it through internal-state interventions. External web search does fit Marcus's narrower point, but it does not rescue the universal assertion. The result depends on treating reasoning and planning as included in “everything else.”
limitations: The decisive study comes from the model developer.
The authors acknowledge that their method captures only part of the computation and may introduce artifacts.
The finding establishes a limited internal capability, not reliable general reasoning.
A reading restricted to external information access would require a different assessment.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Capabilities beyond word correlation are bolted onto LLMs with variable reliability.

statement.excerpt: Everything else is glommed on top, with more or less reliabilty.
statement.document_title: Why ChatGPT can’t be trusted with breaking news

our_interpretation: In context, the ordinary broad reading is that capabilities beyond word correlation, including reasoning and world representation, come from components added around the language model.
External search and application instructions qualify as added components. Computations learned within the model do not.
For this ongoing architectural claim, I use 2025, the latest completed calendar year before the post. Architecture research has no standardized quarterly reporting period.
A demonstrated internal capability can contradict the universal architectural assertion without establishing general intelligence or dependable performance.
criteria.support_condition: Architecture descriptions and controlled evaluations show that capabilities beyond word correlation depend on external additions, with differing reliability.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Mechanistic or controlled evidence establishes a meaningful reasoning, planning, or world-representation capability within the language model itself, rather than supplied by an external component.

evidence.locator: Poetry case study, immediately before the internal-state intervention
evidence.explanation: Researchers traced advance rhyme planning inside Claude and changed planned words by intervening on internal representations. This supplies a counterexample to the broad assertion that such capabilities are supplied entirely by external additions.

Web search is an added tool, consistent with the narrower architectural point. Its existence does not show that every capability beyond word correlation comes from external components or establish their reliability.
